notes_for_editor: Built dates come from one Maine Memory photo record (c. 1920), so 1911-12 and 1918 are the record's dates. Fate and staffing after 1920 are not in any source read; the FFLA list gives only gone. Height 48 ft is converted to 14.6 m; the record does not say whether that runs to the cab floor, so check before using height_m. Agency wording differs: the 1920 record says Forest Service, the 1921 map credit says Maine Forestry Service. Lead, not used: FFLA Maine chapter Facebook snippets (search results only; the pages returned a login shell) say a second Otter Lake tower was erected 1918 and abandoned in the 1950s, and a Facebook photo caption mentions a tower footing on the summit. Check these against a readable source. The Digital Maine map page could supply a preview image; its license was not checked, so no photos added.
